verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single overview line saying Grok Bot lets users "hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer". That implies first-party autonomous work running off-device, but nothing documents setting up automations, triggers or recurring schedules. Realtime multi-agent research is interactive, not background, so it is not credited. missing for 10: documented automation setup (triggers, recurring schedules), evidence of unattended background execution and notification of results, in-depth docs for Grok Bot, independent or hands-on corroboration
